001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
012import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
013import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
014
015/**
016 *
017 * @author jimmy
018 */
019public class PropJoinInjectiveRelationCard extends Propagator<Variable> {
020
021    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
022
023    private final SetVar take;
024    private final IntVar takeCard;
025    private final IntVar[] childrenCards;
026    private final IntVar toCard;
027
028    public PropJoinInjectiveRelationCard(SetVar take, IntVar takeCard, IntVar[] childrenCards, IntVar toCard) {
029        super(buildArray(take, takeCard, toCard, childrenCards), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, false);
030        this.take = take;
031        this.takeCard = takeCard;
032        this.childrenCards = childrenCards;
033        this.toCard = toCard;
034    }
035
036    private static Variable[] buildArray(SetVar take, IntVar takeCard, IntVar toCard, IntVar[] childrenCards) {
037        Variable[] array = new Variable[childrenCards.length + 3];
038        array[0] = take;
039        array[1] = takeCard;
040        array[2] = toCard;
041        System.arraycopy(childrenCards, 0, array, 3, childrenCards.length);
042        return array;
043    }
044
045    private boolean isTakeVar(int idx) {
046        return idx == 0;
047    }
048
049    private boolean isTakeCardVar(int idx) {
050        return idx == 1;
051    }
052
053    private boolean isToCardVar(int idx) {
054        return idx == 2;
055    }
056
057    private boolean isChildCardVar(int idx) {
058        return idx >= 3;
059    }
060
061    private int getChildCardVarIndex(int idx) {
062        assert isChildCardVar(idx);
063        return idx - 3;
064    }
065
066//    @Override
067//    public boolean advise(int idxVarInProp, int mask) {
068//        if (isChildCardVar(idxVarInProp)) {
069//            return take.getUB().contains(getChildCardVarIndex(idxVarInProp));
070//        }
071//        return super.advise(idxVarInProp, mask);
072//    }
073    @Override
074    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
075        if (isTakeVar(vIdx)) {
076            return SetEventType.all();
077        }
078        assert isTakeCardVar(vIdx) || isToCardVar(vIdx) || isChildCardVar(vIdx);
079        return IntEventType.boundAndInst();
080    }
081
082    @Override
083    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
084        ISetIterator takeEnv = take.getUB().iterator();
085        while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
086            int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
087            if (i < 0 || i >= childrenCards.length) {
088                take.remove(i, this);
089            }
090        }
091
092        boolean changed;
093        do {
094            int minCard = 0;
095            int maxCard = 0;
096            takeEnv.reset();
097            while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
098                int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
099                IntVar childCard = childrenCards[i];
100                if (take.getLB().contains(i)) {
101                    minCard += childCard.getLB();
102                }
103                maxCard += childCard.getUB();
104            }
105
106            changed = false;
107            toCard.updateLowerBound(minCard, this);
108            toCard.updateUpperBound(maxCard, this);
109
110            int lb = toCard.getLB();
111            int ub = toCard.getUB();
112
113            int minCardInc = 0;
114            int maxCardDec = 0;
115
116            takeEnv.reset();
117            while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
118                int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
119                if (!take.getLB().contains(i)) {
120                    IntVar childCard = childrenCards[i];
121                    if (maxCard - childCard.getUB() < lb) {
122                        take.force(i, this);
123                        minCardInc += childCard.getLB();
124                        changed = true;
125                    } else if (minCard + childCard.getLB() > ub) {
126                        take.remove(i, this);
127                        maxCardDec += childCard.getUB();
128                        changed = true;
129                    }
130                }
131            }
132            minCard += minCardInc;
133            maxCard -= maxCardDec;
134
135            takeEnv.reset();
136            while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
137                int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
138                if (take.getLB().contains(i)) {
139                    changed |= childrenCards[i].updateLowerBound(lb - maxCard + childrenCards[i].getUB(), this);
140                    changed |= childrenCards[i].updateUpperBound(ub - minCard + childrenCards[i].getLB(), this);
141                } else {
142                    if (maxCard - childrenCards[i].getLB() < lb) {
143                        take.force(i, this);
144                    }
145                    if (minCard - childrenCards[i].getUB() > ub) {
146                        take.remove(i, this);
147                    }
148                }
149            }
150        } while (changed);
151
152        int lb = toCard.getLB();
153        int ub = toCard.getUB();
154        int[] envLbs = new int[take.getUB().size() - take.getLB().size()];
155        int[] envUbs = new int[envLbs.length];
156        int kerMinCard = 0;
157        int kerMaxCard = 0;
158        int env = 0;
159        takeEnv.reset();
160        while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
161            int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
162            if (take.getLB().contains(i)) {
163                kerMinCard += childrenCards[i].getLB();
164                kerMaxCard += childrenCards[i].getUB();
165            } else {
166                envLbs[env] = childrenCards[i].getLB();
167                envUbs[env] = childrenCards[i].getUB();
168                env++;
169            }
170        }
171        Arrays.sort(envLbs);
172        Arrays.sort(envUbs);
173        int i;
174        for (i = 0; i < envLbs.length && (kerMinCard < ub || envLbs[i] == 0); i++) {
175            kerMinCard += envLbs[i];
176        }
177        takeCard.updateUpperBound(i + take.getLB().size(), this);
178        for (i = envUbs.length - 1; i >= 0 && kerMaxCard < lb; i--) {
179            kerMaxCard += envUbs[i];
180        }
181        takeCard.updateLowerBound(envUbs.length - 1 - i + take.getLB().size(), this);
182    }
183
184    @Override
185    public ESat isEntailed() {
186        boolean completelyInstantiated = take.isInstantiated() && takeCard.isInstantiated() && toCard.isInstantiated();
187        int minCard = 0;
188        int maxCard = 0;
189        ISetIterator takeEnv = take.getUB().iterator();
190        while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
191            int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
192            if (i >= 0 && i < childrenCards.length) {
193                IntVar childCard = childrenCards[i];
194                completelyInstantiated = completelyInstantiated && childCard.isInstantiated();
195                if (take.getLB().contains(i)) {
196                    minCard += childCard.getLB();
197                }
198                maxCard += childCard.getUB();
199            }
200        }
201
202        if (toCard.getUB() < minCard) {
203            return ESat.FALSE;
204        }
205        if (toCard.getLB() > maxCard) {
206            return ESat.FALSE;
207        }
208
209        return completelyInstantiated ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
210    }
211
212    @Override
213    public String toString() {
214        return "joinInjectiveRelationCard(" + take + ", " + takeCard + ", " + Arrays.toString(childrenCards) + ", " + toCard + ")";
215    }
216}
